department: School of Biological and Behavioural Sciences

deadline.value: Funded studentships are advertised with their own deadlines. Self-funded applications are accepted.
deadline.quote: If you are applying for one of our postgraduate research studentships, please ensure that you complete the formal application before the advertised deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: You must identify a potential supervisor and contact them first. Once they agree to consider your application, you apply formally.
supervisor.quote: Before applying, you will need to identify a potential supervisor for your PhD. | Once you have contacted a potential supervisor, and they have agreed to consider your application further, you will be required to make a formal application.

funding.value: A limited number of funded projects are advertised; self-funded applicants are also accepted.
funding.quote: We have a limited number of funded projects available which are advertised on our postgraduate research studentships page.

also.quote: Applications from candidates intending to self-fund their PhD are also accepted.

entry_route.value: The school's application page does not state whether a master's is needed; the university minimum is an upper second-class honours degree.

notes: Biological Sciences is the school's main PhD programme; the school list has no separate biomedical or neuroscience PhD code.
